In a “bizarre and unprecedented” cyber-attack, hackers had remotely overridden the temperature settings on thousands of freezers, fridges and chiller cabinets pushing them from as low as -27C (-16.6F) to well over 50C (122F). items.whyImportant: 此次事件凸显了关键基础设施在面对网络攻击时的脆弱性及其对食品供应链的潜在威胁。

items.whyImportant: 此举反映了全球南方国家在应对经济冲击时，对国际金融机构政策导向的日益增长的抵触情绪。

items.summaryZh: 巴拉圭科技部长古斯塔沃·维拉特表示，北京因其与台湾的关系而实施的制裁只会加速双方的联合项目。他强调与台北的关系绝不会成为谈判筹码。
items.whyImportant: 此表态凸显了巴拉圭在面对中国外交压力时，坚持维持与台湾外交关系的立场。

items.title: Foreign banks trim China branch networks as low returns test strategy
items.summary: Almost two decades after gaining permission to conduct yuan business for local clients, foreign-funded banks are still refining their strategy in China, where the financial sector is dominated by state-owned lenders. While Citi exited its China retail banking business, other foreign banks have continued to close branches and sub-branches, focusing instead on digitalisation, wealth management and core clients to strengthen their foothold in the market. items.titleZh: 外资银行缩减中国分支机构网络，低回报考验战略
items.summaryZh: 在国有银行主导的中国金融市场中，外资银行正通过关闭分支机构来调整战略。它们正将重心转向数字化、财富管理及核心客户，以巩固市场地位。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了外资银行在面对中国市场激烈竞争和利润压力时，正在进行业务模式的深度转型。

items.title: ‘Hot economics, cold politics’: why China gave nod for expanded Japanese trade trip
items.summary: Beijing’s decision to allow a bigger Japanese business delegation to go to China next month may be cause for some optimism but “hot economics and cold politics” will continue to dominate the strained relationship between the two countries, observers say. Kyodo news agency reported this week that Beijing had agreed to allow the Japanese Business Federation – the country’s most influential business lobby, also known as Keidanren – to expand its delegation coming to China next month. items.titleZh: “经济热，政治冷”：为何中国批准扩大日本贸易代表团访问
items.summaryZh: 北京同意扩大日本经团联代表团下月的访华规模，这被视为一种积极信号。然而观察人士认为，中日关系仍将长期处于“经济热、政治冷”的状态。
items.whyImportant: 该事件显示了中日两国在政治关系紧张背景下，仍试图通过经贸合作维持双边往来。

items.title: Iran war live: IRGC says supertanker hit naval mine in Hormuz, catches fire
items.summary: Iran’s IRGC says an oil supertanker is on fire in the Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine.
items.titleZh: 伊朗战争直播：伊斯兰革命卫队称一艘超级油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触碰水雷起火
items.summaryZh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队报告称，一艘超级油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触碰水雷后起火。目前相关救援和调查工作正在进行中。
items.whyImportant: 霍尔木兹海峡是全球能源运输的关键通道，该事件可能对国际油价及地区航运安全产生重大影响。

items.title: From hospital, Pope Leo pushes Putin for ceasefire in contested Ukraine city
items.summary: Pope Leo spoke with Russian President Vladimir Putin by phone on Friday, calling for a ceasefire in a Russian-occupied city in southern Ukraine, as he recovers in hospital from a lung cancer operation. The Vatican said that Pope Leo “expressed his deep concern about the grave humanitarian situation in the city of Oleshky, in the Kherson region, and called for a ceasefire to allow the delivery of food and medical assistance, and the voluntary and safe evacuation of the civilian population”. items.titleZh: 教皇利奥在医院致电普京，呼吁在乌克兰争议城市停火
items.summaryZh: 正在接受肺癌手术恢复期的教皇利奥与俄罗斯总统普京通电话，呼吁在乌克兰赫尔松地区的奥列什基市停火。教皇希望通过停火实现人道主义援助物资的运送及平民的安全撤离。
items.whyImportant: 教皇的直接干预凸显了冲突地区严峻的人道主义危机，并试图通过外交途径缓解当地局势。

items.titleZh: “阿尔忒弥斯2号”溅落后的隔热罩分析
items.summaryZh: NASA在“阿尔忒弥斯2号”任务结束后，对猎户座飞船的隔热罩进行了详细检查。分析结果证实，该热防护系统在飞船重返大气层过程中有效保护了机组人员和飞船系统。
items.whyImportant: 这一分析结果验证了深空探测关键技术的可靠性，为未来载人航天任务的安全性提供了重要数据支持。
